name: FLIXO Arabic Agent routes a compound image request to a two-step plan
description: The Arabic Agent surface must preserve RTL and produce the same deterministic compound plan semantics.

planSteps.description: Verify the document direction is RTL
Enter `اضغط الصورة إلى أقل من 200 كيلوبايت وحولها WebP` in the Agent command field
Verify the plan-ready card is visible
Verify the plan-ready card reports exactly 2 steps
Verify no result preview is displayed before an image is attached and execution is confirmed
